analysis: Bitcoin has broken below the value area lower bound (84,100) driven heavily by aggressive derivative market selling with perp volume outpacing spot by more than two to one. While aligned negative spot and perp CVD reinforce short-term downside conviction, the derivative-led nature of the move elevates late-short exhaustion risk.
key_risk: A sharp mean-reversion reclaim above VAL (84,100) triggering a forced short-squeeze back toward the POC.
